svg.title: The Bid That Wasn't Read: Tract 45869 at the November 13, 2024 Louisiana mineral lease sale
svg.desc: Final Vestige Studios original evidence diagram. Louisiana advertised Tract 45869 in Plaquemines Parish as approximately 107 net mineral acres. The complete official public bid-opening minutes list bids for surrounding tract numbers but none for 45869. Nine state agency tracts covering 481.553 acres were nominated; eight covering 374.553 acres were awarded, a 107-acre difference. The absence from the November 13 bid reading does not prove a reason, future lease status, or claimant payment.
